message: In the calendar's Day and 3 Day views, touch and hold an empty time and drag down to make an event that long. Touch and hold an event to move it (in 3 Day, drag it sideways to move it to another day), or hold the grip at its bottom edge to change when it ends. Tapping an event now opens it on its own, with how soon it starts and a Join button when it has a video call link.
